title: hypericum tomentosum var. lusitanicum
intro: Hypericum tomentosum var. lusitanicum, commonly known as the Portuguese St. John's Wort, is a perennial herb of the Hypericum genus, characterized by its hairy leaves and yellow flowers. The health benefits of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat anxiety, insomnia, and mild depression. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum tomentosum var. lusitanicum are attributed to its ability to modulate the activity of neurotransmitters and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
